what_is_it.heading: Isilungulela kanye ne-reflux ngamagama alula
what_is_it.lede: Isilungulela umuzwa ovuthayo esifubeni noma emphinjeni obangelwa i-asidi yesisu egeleza ihlehla epayipini lokudla. Uma kwenzeka kaningi, kubizwa ngokuthi i-GORD (isifo se-reflux ye-gastro-oesophageal).
paragraphs: Ivalvu ephakathi kwesisu nepayipi lokudla ihloselwe ukuhlala ivaliwe. Uma iphumuza kaningi noma iyinde kakhulu, i-asidi ibalekela phezulu. Umphumela: ukuzwa kushisa, ukuvutha ngemuva kwethambo lesifuba - ngokuvamile ngemva kokudla, ngokuvamile kubi kakhulu ukulala phansi.

Isilungulela ngezikhathi ezithile ngemva kokudla okukhulu kuvamile. Isilungulela esenzeka kabili ngeviki noma ngaphezulu, noma esikuvusa ebusuku, sidinga ukunakwa. Ingalimaza ipayipi lokudla phakathi neminyaka. Izindaba ezinhle: izinguquko zendlela yokuphila kanye nemithi elula isebenza kahle kakhulu kubantu abaningi.

items.headline: 1 em4
items.body: Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika baba nesilungulela okungenani kanye ngesonto. Abaningi kakhulu baba nayo ngezikhathi ezithile. Kuvame kakhulu.

items.headline: Kuyalapheka
items.body: Izinguquko zendlela yokuphila kanye nemithi elula (i-PPIs efana ne-omeprazole) isebenza kahle kakhulu. Abantu abaningi bathola ukukhululeka okukhulu phakathi kwamaviki ama-2.

items.headline: Angalingisa inhliziyo
items.body: Isilungulela esibi kakhulu singazwakala njengokuhlasela kwenhliziyo. Uma ungabaza - ikakhulukazi ngokujuluka, ukuphelelwa umoya, ubuhlungu bemihlathi noma ingalo - thatha inhliziyo bese ushayela ku-10177.

items.headline: Buka amafulegi abomvu
items.body: Ubunzima bokugwinya, ukuncipha, ukuhlanza igazi, indle emnyama - lokhu akusona isilungulela. Bonana nodokotela ngaphandle kokulibala.

pull_quote.text: Uma uthatha imithi yesilungulela nsuku zonke isikhathi esingaphezu kwamasonto ambalwa, thola ukuhlolwa okufanele. I-acid reflux yesikhathi eside ingalimaza ipayipi lokudla futhi ayivamisile ukuholela emdlavuza - kokubili kungavinjelwa ngokunakekelwa okufanele.

signs.heading: Okufanele ukubheke
signs.lede: Isilungulela sinephethini evamile - kodwa ezinye izimpawu zixwayisa ngokuthile okubucayi kakhulu.

items.title: Isilungulela esijwayelekile
items.description: Ukushisa ngemuva kwethambo lesifuba, ngokuvamile ngemva kokudla. Ukunambitheka okumuncu noma okubabayo ngemuva komphimbo. Okubi nakakhulu ukulala phansi, ukugoba, noma ngemva kokudla okukhulu noma okunamafutha. Ukukhululwa kuma-antacid.

items.title: Izici ze-Reflux
items.description: I-Acid efika emphinjeni noma emlonyeni, ikakhulukazi ebusuku. Ukukhwehlela okungapheli noma ukuhayiza. Ngezinye izikhathi izimpawu ezifana ne-asthma noma i-asthma. Okubi nakakhulu ngokukhuluphala noma ukukhulelwa.

items.title: Amafulegi abomvu - bonana nodokotela
items.description: Ubunzima noma ubuhlungu bokugwinya, ukudla okunamathelayo, ukuncipha komzimba, ukuhlanza igazi, indle emnyama, ubuhlungu besifuba obunzima — okungenzeka kube yisifo senhliziyo. Akukho kulokhu 'okuyisilungulela nje'.

items.fact: Ubisi luvimba i-asidi kafushane, bese ngokuvamile lwenza izinto zibe zimbi nakakhulu - amafutha obisi abangela ukukhululwa kwe-asidi eyengeziwe. Sebenzisa ama-antacid adizayinelwe umsebenzi (isb., i-Gaviscon).

items.myth: I-Reflux imane nje iwukungakhululeki — ayibangeli umonakalo wangempela.
items.fact: Iminyaka eminingi ye-reflux engelashiwe ingalimaza ulwelwesi lwamapayipi okudla (i-esophagitis), ibangele ukuncipha, futhi kuyaqabukela iholele esimweni esiyingozi. Kufanelekile ukuphathwa, hhayi nje ukubekezela.

items.myth: Isilungulela njalo ngemva kokudla ukudla okubabayo.
items.fact: Izimbangela ezivamile ziyahlukahluka: ikhofi, ukudla okunamafutha, ushokoledi, utshwala, i-peppermint, i-citrus, ukudla okukhulu, ukudla sekwephuzile. Abantu abahlukene banezicucu ezihlukene. Idayari yokudla iyasiza.

Ukunciphisa umzimba kusiza kakhulu, ikakhulukazi okhalweni. Kodwa abantu abaningi abazacile bane-reflux futhi - futhi isisindo akusona ukuphela kwesici. Hlanganisa ukuphathwa kwesisindo nezinye izinguquko.

prevention.heading: Imikhuba yansuku zonke esiza
prevention.lede: Izinguquko zendlela yokuphila ngokuvamile zinamandla kakhulu kunemithi ye-reflux emaphakathi kuya emaphakathi. Kufanelekile ukuzama amaviki angu-4 ngaphambi kokuthola amaphilisi unomphela.

items.title: Izidlo ezincane, yidla kancane
items.description: Izidlo ezinkulu zigcwalisa isisu futhi ziphushe i-asidi phezulu. Zama izingxenye ezincane, yidla kancane, ungabuyeli emuva imizuzwana ngesikhathi esifanayo.

items.title: Ungadli engakapheli amahora ama-3 ulele
items.description: Ukulala ngesisu esigcwele kuyindlela yokwelapha i-reflux ebusuku. Ukudla kokugcina okungenani amahora ama-3 ngaphambi kokulala. Ukudla okulula kuphela uma kudingeka.

items.title: Avuse ikhanda lombhede
items.description: Faka amabhlogo angu-10-15cm ngaphansi kwemilenze ye-headboard (hhayi nje imicamelo eyengeziwe - lokhu kugoba intamo). Amandla adonsela phansi agcina i-asidi iphansi ebusuku.

items.title: Sika izibangeli zakho
items.description: Okuvamile: ikhofi, utshwala, ukudla okunamafutha, ushokoledi, i-peppermint, i-citrus, ukudla okubabayo, ukubhema, amabhande aqinile okhalweni. Yeka ukubhema ngokuphelele - kwenza i-valve ibe buthaka ngokuqondile.

items.title: Zama izinguquko zendlela yokuphila amaviki angu-4
items.description: Izidlo ezincane, ukungadli sekwephuzile, umbhede ophakanyisiwe, khomba izinto ezibangisayo. Cishe uhhafu wabantu uthola impumuzo enkulu kulokhu kuphela - ayikho imithi edingekayo.

items.title: Zama ama-antacid angaphandle kwekhawunta ngezikhathi ezithile
items.description: I-Gaviscon, i-Rennies, noma umsebenzi ofanayo ngokushesha ngeziqephu zezikhathi ezithile. Itholakala kunoma yiliphi ikhemisi. Ungawasebenzisi nsuku zonke — lokho kuwuphawu lokuthi udinga indlela ehlukile.

items.title: Uma izimpawu izikhathi ezingu-2+ ngesonto - bona umtholampilo
items.description: Ama-PPI (i-omeprazole, i-esomeprazole) asetshenziswa amaviki ama-4-8 avame ukusebenza kahle kakhulu. Kumahhala emitholampilo kahulumeni. Ungawathathi unomphela ngaphandle kokubuyekezwa kwezokwelapha.

items.title: Uma kuvela amafulegi abomvu - hamba ngaphandle kokulibala
items.description: Ubunzima bokugwinya, ukuncipha kwesisindo, ukuhlanza igazi, indle emnyama - lokhu kudinga ukuhlolwa okuphuthumayo, ngezinye izikhathi i-endoscopy. Ungazami ukwelashwa okutholakala ekhawuntaleni kwalokhu.

items.title: Uma ubuhlungu besifuba - thatha inhliziyo kuqala
items.description: Ukuhlasela kwenhliziyo nesilungulela kungase kuzwakale okufanayo. Ngokujuluka, ukuphelelwa umoya, ubuhlungu bomhlathi noma bengalo, nanoma yikuphi ukungaqiniseki — shayela ku-10177. Uphephe kangcono.

get_help.heading: Lapho okumele uye khona
get_help.lede: Iningi le-reflux lingalawulwa ezingeni lasemtholampilo. Izimpawu eziphikelelayo noma amafulegi abomvu azuza ekudlulisweni kochwepheshe.

helplines.name: I-ambulensi yezimo eziphuthumayo
helplines.description: Uma ubuhlungu besifuba bungase bube yisifo senhliziyo

helplines.name: Thola umtholampilo oseduze nawe
helplines.description: Ukuhlolwa kwamahhala, iseluleko sendlela yokuphila, kanye nokwelashwa okubhalwe udokotela
helplines.meta: Akukho ukuqokwa · alukho usizo lwezempilo oludingekayo

helplines.name: Noma yiliphi ikhemisi lendawo
helplines.description: Ama-antacid angaphandle kwekhawunta ukuze asetshenziswe ngezikhathi ezithile
